hints.title: Occurrence Frequency Counting
hints.text: Tally the frequency of each distinct value present in the array.

hints.title: Single Occurrence Filtering
hints.text: Filter out values that appear twice to isolate items occurring exactly once.

hints.title: Ascending Order Output
hints.text: Sort the remaining unique values in ascending numerical order.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: K: number of elements appearing once
complexity.notes: Linear frequency mapping followed by sorting filtered candidates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise nested comparisons take O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash frequency map trades linear memory for constant time updates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify values with frequency 1 and return them sorted.
